title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.4 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive… (CVE-2026-84228)
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection version 12.2.4 contains a vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper input validation. The vulnerability has a low severity score and requires low privileges to exploit. There is no indication of active exploitation in the wild or available patches at this time.
